reason: All opcodes are NMOS-era (CMP abs,X DD, BCC, BNE), real on the 65SC12. Bytes: old LDA abs,X(3)+CMP zp(2)+BCC(2)=7, new CMP abs,X(3)+BCC(2)+BNE(2)=7, so nothing after DF2E moves (listing: sky_col_row DF1F, BCC at DF2E; .no stays at DF48, BNE from DF30 in range; BCC +2 to skyrow_in at DF32, same page). sky_ry is &BCB4, X < SKY_ROWS=6, so sky_ry,X never crosses a page; sky_stop is zp &E2 and not self-modified; no stores to sky_col_row+n anywhere. Cycles: pass path old 4+3+2=9, new 7 when stop<ry (BCC taken, no page cross), 8 when equal; 'no' path old 4+3+3=10, new 4+2+3=9. Condition: old exits iff ry<stop; new CMP computes stop-ry, exits iff C=1 and Z=0 i.e. stop>ry: identical. Both callers (sky_col_check, sky_col_zero) only BCS on return and then reload A, so A=stop instead of ry on exit is dead (pass path overwrites A at LDA sky_rl,X anyway).
